title: Strategic Customer Admission Flow and Commitment Guardrails
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description: Create a formal "admission" flow for strategic customers whose requests require roadmap commitments or SLA-level responses. This ticket defines the qualification criteria, commitment guardrails, cross-functional review gates, and the handoff artifacts required for PM + Eng + Solutions to commit roadmap work for high-touch accounts. Goal is to reduce ad-hoc promises, improve predictability for sales and CSMs, and ensure commitments map to measurable OKRs.
goals: Define a clear qualification rubric for strategic commitments (revenue threshold, regulatory risk, strategic signals)
Ship a lightweight decision gate and artifact template that PMs can use to evaluate requests within 2 business days
Ensure every commitment has a linked technical feasibility note, expected SLA, and measurable success metric
Reduce informal roadmap promises to customers by 80% inside three months
success_metrics: % of high-touch requests processed through the admission flow >= 90%
Commitment slippage (missed delivery beyond agreed window) <= 10% for admitted items
Reduction in customer escalations related to roadmap commitments by 50%
acceptance_criteria: Qualification rubric doc published and approved by GTM, Sales Ops, and Legal
Admission form + template created in Confluence and linked to the Console roadmap item type
PM review panel (rotating) and Engineering triage SLA documented and staffed
Rollout training for Solutions and CSMs completed (recorded session + slides)
A pilot with 3 active strategic customers completed and results logged in Dashboard
design_notes: Design should add a dedicated 'Strategic Commitment' flag on roadmap items visible in Console
Mockups include an expandable review panel with links to feasibility notes, cost estimates, and fallback policies
Keep UX low-friction: admission form 5 fields + attach links; progress indicator for review state
engineering_notes: Backend: add 'commitment_level' enum (none, strategic, enterprise) to roadmap API; migration script required
Console: surface 'Commitment guardrails' section on item detail page and link to associated GitHub tickets
Telemetry: emit events for admission_submitted, admission_approved, admission_rejected for KPI dashboards
Estimate: 5 pts (API + Console surface + telemetry + migration)
rollout_plan: Week 0: Publish qualification rubric internally and collect feedback
Week 1: Ship Confluence templates and Console flag; start 2-week pilot with Solutions team
Week 3: Review pilot metrics, iterate templates, and finalize training materials
Week 4: Roll out to Sales/CS with recorded training; enable telemetry dashboards for PM leadership
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales bypasses process for urgent deals -> Mitigation: include Sales Ops enforcement and require approval token for deal playbooks
Risk: Engineering capacity squeeze from admitted commitments -> Mitigation: admission must include resource estimate + alignment to Dedicated capacity lanes
Risk: Ambiguous qualification signals lead to noise -> Mitigation: maintain required signal checklist and quarterly calibration reviews
